reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin centered on balance monitoring, low-balance indicators, API quota queries, and usage analytics, with secondary plugin-management and top-up-link features.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中监控账户余额、查看用量统计、显示低余额提示并管理相关插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for monitoring account balances, viewing usage statistics, showing low-balance indicators, and managing related plugins.

capabilities: Reads and queries DeepSeek API account balances using configured API keys
Aggregates local session and event history into usage statistics
Displays low-balance indicators and configurable thresholds
Provides links to DeepSeek top-up and usage pages
Lists local third-party plugins and can open their source directories
Installs and removes the plugin through shell or PowerShell scripts
